description: This source file defines a script for running a video streaming bot using Pipecat framework. It sets up command line argument parsing, initializes a GStreamer pipeline source for reading video files, configures transport parameters, and defines asynchronous functions to start and run the bot with specified input and transport settings.

classes.name: GStreamerPipelineSource
classes.description: A source class that wraps a GStreamer pipeline to read media from a file.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: A class representing a sequence of processing steps or sources for the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a pipeline task with specific execution parameters such as idle timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution and control flow of pipeline tasks.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Configuration parameters for running the pipeline, such as timeout and signal handling options.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: An abstract class defining transport interface for video/audio data transfer.

classes.name: DailyParams
classes.description: Transport parameters specific to Daily transport implementation.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Initializes and runs the Pipecat pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Entry point for starting the bot with parameters, creates transport, and invokes run_bot.
